coverage_gaps: No person-specific event involving a covered right-wing, Republican, conservative, or affiliated-organizational figure was located in Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, or Missouri that met the evidence and date-window rules.

Ohio, Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, and Michigan official indexes showed no qualifying new covered-person misconduct action in the window; visible releases were unrelated, concerned private defendants or ordinary employees without documented covered affiliation, or predated the window.
Missouri's August 17 Attorney General item concerned internal public-service awards; the latest relevant Missouri official misconduct/removal items located were outside the 24-hour window.

Indiana and Michigan press-release and court indexes use dynamic or partially searchable interfaces, and local police, sheriff, prosecutor, court, school-board, municipal, and ethics records are fragmented rather than exposed through one statewide index.

Several major regional-news domains were blocked by robots.txt. AP and broad regional-news searches produced no in-window qualifying report; no social-media or partisan item met the threshold for a retained quarantine lead.
